utility.notes: Orinda is a well-documented Contra Costa County city within PG&E's core Northern California service territory.

generation_supplier.notes: Orinda is not listed among MCE's 16 current Contra Costa County member communities (MCE's own service-area page). No CCA was found serving Orinda this session.

permit_authority.notes: The City of Orinda's own Building Permits page directly confirms Orinda does not have its own building department and contracts with Contra Costa County for building services; Orinda's Planning Department handles zoning review but not permit issuance.

interconnection_url.notes: PG&E's own utility-wide Net Energy Metering (NEM) program page.

inspection_steps.notes: The page describes the plan-submittal and plan-check-fee process but does not itself detail the inspection-scheduling process; inspections are handled by Contra Costa County (925-646-4108 per the County's own SolarAPP+ page).

value.program_or_pathway: Contra Costa County building permit (Orinda contracts building services to the County)
other_conditions: Planning Department review is not required for flush, roof-mounted solar on residential properties, regardless of system size
A building permit is mandatory for any solar installation
Additional clearances may be required from the Sanitary District/Environmental Health (for septic systems) or the Moraga-Orinda Fire District

permit_fees.notes: The page directs applicants to Contra Costa County's Building Department for pricing; a specific dollar figure was not stated on the city's own page.
